en: 4. The Question on the Salakalyāṇī Tree “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘one quality of the salakalyāṇī tree should be adopted,’ which is that one quality that should be adopted?
“Just as, Great King, the so-called salakalyāṇī tree grows right out of the interior of the earth, even to a height of a hundred cubits or more;”

In the same way, Great King, a yogi, a practitioner of yoga, must fulfill the four fruits of asceticism, the four analytical knowledges, the six direct knowledges, and the entire duty of a recluse only in an empty dwelling.
This, Great King, is one quality to be taken from the noble *sāla* tree.
And this was said, Great King, by the Elder Rāhula:
‘There is a tree growing from the earth called Sālakalyāṇikā;
even within the interior of the ground, it stands firm.’
It grows even to a hundred cubits.
Just as when its time has arrived,
Having emerged, even one with a hundred hands grows for a single day;
even so am I, O Great Hero.
they have caused the Dhamma to flourish."
The fourth question on the beautiful sal-tree.
